order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 112 needs public.moov_invoices and public.moov_invoice_customers (restored Supabase schema, migration 20260819015105) owned by checksops_admin and the roles checksops and authenticated. The production invoice handler (aws/functions/api/providers/production/moov-invoice.mjs, live since 2026-10-23 through the guarded overlay runs 39955069311 and 39955539299) reads and writes moov_invoices (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and reads and inserts moov_invoice_customers; in this repository only the supabase migration grants those tables (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE to authenticated, ALL to service_role) and nothing grants checksops. The owner sent an invoice from Payments on 2026-10-23, so production holds at least the lines that send used; the read-only inspect records which of the pinned lines are held. If every pinned line is held the inspect reports already_applied true and nothing is applied (the pin is then recorded as verified live, not applied). SQL 112 grants SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE on moov_invoices and SELECT and INSERT on moov_invoice_customers to checksops and authenticated and changes nothing else. No later migration revokes these grants.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 112: sql112-moov-invoice-table-grants-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql112-moov-invoice-table-grants); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql112. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): the SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE grants of checksops and authenticated on public.moov_invoices and their SELECT and INSERT grants on public.moov_invoice_customers (spec table_privileges). The post-conditions also require every other grant on each of the two tables unchanged (other_table_privileges_unchanged) and the rest of the catalog unchanged. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.

Which pinned lines checksops and authenticated hold is unknown until the inspect (the supabase migration granted authenticated all four privileges; the owner's invoice send of 2026-10-23 shows checksops can at least read and insert moov_invoices). staging_acceptance.basis: Pending: record the guarded staging SQL executor read-live run of SQL 112 (choice sql112-moov-invoice-table-grants) and, where the read-live reports already_applied false, its staging apply run here in the reviewed change that sets execute true. The read-live records which pinned lines staging holds; where it reports already_applied true (every pinned line held) there is nothing to apply in staging and the read-live itself is the staging evidence. Otherwise the staging pin records that pre-state and the owner approves the staging apply, and the apply run (receipt before == the recorded pre-state, after == intended) is the staging evidence. The grants are covered on PostgreSQL 16 by aws/tests/sql112-moov-invoice-table-grants-pg.test.mjs. Until then the tool refuses this pin with SQL_COLLISION (expected_live_definition_sha256 is null) and PRODUCTION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED (no owner approval or staging acceptance).
